description: Controlled benchmark fixture for evaluating Plimsol's ability to generate QA test cases from business requirements and Salesforce org metadata. Tests 10 progressively complex validation rule patterns.

validation_rules.capability_tested: Simple boundary: numeric field must be positive when populated; blank is allowed
Conditional required field: text field becomes mandatory based on a percentage threshold with exact boundary
Compound boolean logic: AND of a numeric condition with OR of a percentage threshold and picklist membership
Picklist-driven required field: text field is mandatory only at specific stage values
Change detection: field lock after reaching a specific stage using ISCHANGED and PRIORVALUE
Date boundary: date field is mandatory and must be today or later at a specific stage
Multiple failure conditions: two independent requirements that both must be satisfied for a specific picklist value
Record type context: percentage cap that applies only to a specific record type; other record types are unaffected
Text pattern validation: REGEX enforcement of a specific format when the field is populated
Composite business logic: multi-condition gate on a stage transition combining picklist, numeric, boolean, date, and change-detection checks

permission_set.description: Full CRUD + FLS for the benchmark object and all fields
